images.title: Naming a rectangle in order
images.purpose: Show that a rectangle is named by its corners in order round the edge.
images.composition: One rectangle in the centre with corner letters and a curved arrow running round the edge, wide margins.
images.exact_structure: One teal #0072B2 rectangle 6 units by 4 units with corners A at bottom left, B at bottom right, C at top right, D at top left. A reddish purple #CC79A7 arrow runs round the edge A to B to C to D and back to A. Nothing else. Exactly 4 letters and 1 arrow.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
letters out of order round the edge
images.takeaway: Name a rectangle by walking round its edge.
images.description: A teal rectangle with corners A, B, C, D in order round the edge and a purple arrow going round the edge from A back to A.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to walk a finger round the edge and read the letters aloud.

image_decisions.why: Corners in order round the edge is one picture.
